ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/desktop/examples/App.vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import MinimalDesktop from '../templates/desktop/MinimalDesktop.vue';
import ExamplePanel from '../templates/desktop/examples/ExamplePanel.vue';
import { createDesktop } from '../templates/desktop/Desktop.js';
import { browserStorage } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { panels, desktopConfig } from '../templates/desktop/examples/config.js';
import type { Scope } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	const placeholder = defineComponent(() => () => h('div'));
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: placeholder },
			{ path: '/guide', component: placeholder }
		]
	});
	const application = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	application.mount(element);
	if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('test'))
		Object.assign(window, {
			desktopApplication: application,
			createDesktopPeer(owner: Scope) {
				const container = document.createElement('div');
				container.dataset.peer = 'true';
				document.body.append(container);
				const controller = createDesktop({
					app: desktopConfig.app,
					owner,
					scope: desktopConfig.scope,
					panels,
					storage: browserStorage()
				});
				const peer = createApp({
					render: () =>
						h(
							AsamApplicationProvider,
							{},
							{
								default: () =>
									h(
										MinimalDesktop,
										{ controller, title: '独立工作台' },
										{
											panel: (scope: {
												panel: { id: string };
												readonly: boolean;
											}) =>
												h(ExamplePanel, {
													id: scope.panel.id,
													readonly: scope.readonly,
													disabled: false
												})
										}
									)
							}
						)
				});
				peer.mount(container);
				return {
					controller,
					destroy() {
						peer.unmount();
						controller.dispose();
						container.remove();
					}
				};
			}
		});

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

			</header>

				ref="stage"
				:controller="controller"

				><template #panel="scope"><slot name="panel" v-bind="scope" /></template

			</footer>
		</div>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useId } from 'vue';
import DesktopStage from './DesktopStage.vue';
import { useDesktopCopy } from './I18n.js';
import type { DesktopExpose, DesktopPageProps, DesktopSlots } from './Types.js';
defineProps<DesktopPageProps>();
defineSlots<DesktopSlots>();
defineEmits<{ (e: 'retry', id: string): void }>();
const copy = useDesktopCopy();
const stage = ref<DesktopExpose>();
const mainId = useId();
defineExpose({ focus: () => stage.value?.focus(), cancel: () => stage.value?.cancel() });
</script>

ts
import { computed, readonly, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { createBusinessCache } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { encodeScope } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type { Scope, StorageAdapter } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type {
	DesktopOptions,
	DesktopPanel,
	DesktopWindow,
	LayoutSnapshot,
	LayoutStatus,
	WindowRect
} from './Types.js';

const copy = <T>(v: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
const record = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> =>
	typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const exact = (v: Record<string, unknown>, keys: string[]) =>
	Object.keys(v).length === keys.length && keys.every((k) => Object.hasOwn(v, k));
const rectValid = (v: unknown): v is WindowRect =>
	record(v) &&
	exact(v, ['x', 'y', 'width', 'height']) &&
	Object.values(v).every(
		(n) => typeof n === 'number' && Number.isFinite(n) && Math.abs(n) <= 100000
	) &&
	Number(v.width) > 0 &&
	Number(v.height) > 0;
export function validateLayout(v: unknown): v is LayoutSnapshot {
	if (
		!record(v) ||
		!exact(v, ['version', 'windows', 'active']) ||
		v.version !== 1 ||
		!Array.isArray(v.windows) ||
		v.windows.length > 32
	)
		return false;
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	for (const w of v.windows) {
		if (
			!record(w) ||
			!exact(w, ['id', 'rect', 'minimized', 'maximized']) ||
			typeof w.id !== 'string' ||
			!w.id ||
			w.id.length > 128 ||
			ids.has(w.id) ||
			!rectValid(w.rect) ||
			typeof w.minimized !== 'boolean' ||
			typeof w.maximized !== 'boolean'
		)
			return false;
		ids.add(w.id);
	}
	return (
		v.active === null ||
		(typeof v.active === 'string' &&
			ids.has(v.active) &&

	};
	target.focus();
	target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function move(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointer) return;
	const dx = event.clientX - drag.x,
		dy = event.clientY - drag.y;
	preview.value = {
		id: drag.id,
		rect: clampRect(
			{
				...drag.rect,
				...(drag.mode === 'move'
					? { x: drag.rect.x + dx, y: drag.rect.y + dy }
					: { width: drag.rect.width + dx, height: drag.rect.height + dy })
			},
			c.viewport.value.width,
			c.viewport.value.height
		)
	};
}
function finish(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointer) return;
	const current = drag,
		value = preview.value;
	cancel();
	if (
		surface.value?.clientWidth !== current.width ||
		surface.value?.clientHeight !== current.height
	)
		return;
	if (value) c.setRect(current.id, value.rect);
}
function escape(event: KeyboardEvent) {
	if (event.key === 'Escape' && drag) {
		event.preventDefault();
		event.stopPropagation();
		cancel();
	}
}
function keyRect(event: KeyboardEvent, w: Readonly<DesktopWindow>, mode: 'move' | 'resize') {
	if (
		!['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(event.key) ||
		event.altKey ||
		event.metaKey ||
		event.ctrlKey
	)
		return;
	event.preventDefault();
	cancel();
	const r = c.displayRect(w),
		step = event.shiftKey ? 32 : 8;
	const dx = event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -step : event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? step : 0;
	const dy = event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -step : event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? step : 0;
	c.setRect(w.id, {
		...r,
		...(mode === 'move'
			? { x: r.x + dx, y: r.y + dy }
			: { width: r.width + dx, height: r.height + dy })
	});
}
watch(() => c.revision.value, cancel, { flush: 'sync' });
watch(
	() => c.focusRevision.value,
	async () => {
		await nextTick();
		if (!root.value?.isConnected) return;
		const target = c.active.value ? elements.get(c.active.value) : undefined;
		if (target && !target.contains(document.activeElement))
			target.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.desktop-move')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
		else if (
			!target &&
			(!document.activeElement ||
				document.activeElement === document.body ||
				!root.value.contains(document.activeElement))
		)
			root.value
				.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-open]:not(:disabled)')
				?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
	}
);
function storage(event: StorageEvent) {
	c.externalChange(event.key);
}
onMounted(() => {
	observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
		cancel();
		if (surface.value) c.setViewport(surface.value.clientWidth, surface.value.clientHeight);
	});
	if (surface.value) {
		c.setViewport(surface.value.clientWidth, surface.value.clientHeight);
		observer.observe(surface.value);
	}
	window.addEventListener('blur', cancel);
	window.addEventListener('scroll', cancel, true);
	window.addEventListener('storage', storage);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	cancel();
	observer?.disconnect();
	elements.clear();
	window.removeEventListener('blur', cancel);
	window.removeEventListener('scroll', cancel, true);
	window.removeEventListener('storage', storage);
});
defineExpose({ focus: () => root.value?.focus(), cancel });
</script>

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Scope, StorageAdapter, StorageStatus } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import type { DesktopController } from './Desktop.js';

export type DesktopFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type PanelStatus = 'ready' | 'loading' | 'empty' | 'error';
export interface WindowRect {
	x: number;
	y: number;
	width: number;
	height: number;
}
export interface DesktopPanel {
	id: string;
	title: string;
	description?: string;
	/** Current host authority; never restored from storage. */
	allowed: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
	status?: PanelStatus;
	initial?: Partial<WindowRect>;
	initialOpen?: boolean;
}
export interface DesktopWindow {
	id: string;
	rect: WindowRect;
	minimized: boolean;
	maximized: boolean;
}
export interface LayoutSnapshot {
	version: 1;
	windows: DesktopWindow[];
	active: string | null;
}
export type LayoutStatus = StorageStatus | 'conflict';
export interface DesktopOptions {
	app: string;
	owner: Scope;
	scope: Scope;
	panels: readonly DesktopPanel[];
	storage?: StorageAdapter;
	ttl?: number;
	now?: () => number;
	/** A strictly smaller container is narrow; default 720 CSS px. */
	breakpoint?: number;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
}
export interface DesktopPageProps {
	controller: DesktopController;
	title?: string;
	description?: string;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
}
export interface DesktopPanelScope {
	panel: Readonly<DesktopPanel>;
	window: Readonly<DesktopWindow>;
	readonly: boolean;
	close: () => boolean;
}
export interface DesktopSlots {
	panel?: (scope: DesktopPanelScope) => VNode[];
	navigation?: () => VNode[];
	footer?: () => VNode[];
}
export interface DesktopExpose {
	focus: () => void;
	cancel: () => void;
}

	confirmDeliverables: '确认本周交付清单',
	today: '今天',
	reviewDesign: '核对设计与实现',
	organizeRecords: '整理协作记录',
	thisWeek: '本周',
	draft: '当前草稿',
	draftPlaceholder: '写下接下来要处理的事…',
	draftHint: '移动、切换和最小化会保留草稿。关闭或权限撤回后释放。',

	reviewComplete: '完成视觉走查',
	docsUpdated: '更新组件使用说明',
	planShared: '同步本周计划',
	activityRefreshed: '动态已刷新',
	refresh: '刷新动态',
	refreshing: '正在刷新',
	loaded: '已加载'
};
const en: typeof zh = {
	pending: 'To do',
	localDemo: 'Local demo data',
	confirmDeliverables: 'Confirm the weekly deliverables',
	today: 'Today',
	reviewDesign: 'Review the design and implementation',
	organizeRecords: 'Organize team records',
	thisWeek: 'This week',
	draft: 'Current draft',
	draftPlaceholder: 'Write down what to do next…',
	draftHint:

	workspace: 'Collaboration workspace',
	reviewComplete: 'Completed the visual review',
	docsUpdated: 'Updated the component guide',
	planShared: 'Shared the weekly plan',
	activityRefreshed: 'Activity refreshed',
	refresh: 'Refresh activity',
	refreshing: 'Refreshing',
	loaded: 'Loaded'
};
const locale = useDesktopLocale();
const copy = computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh));
const props = defineProps<{ id: string; readonly: boolean; disabled: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'lifecycle', event: string, id: string): void }>();
const instance = useId();
type ActivityLabel = 'reviewComplete' | 'docsUpdated' | 'planShared' | 'activityRefreshed';
const draft = ref(''),
	activities = ref<{ id: number; label: ActivityLabel }[]>([
		{ id: 0, label: 'reviewComplete' },
		{ id: 1, label: 'docsUpdated' },
		{ id: 2, label: 'planShared' }

	loading = ref(false);
let nextActivityId = 3;
const draftAttributes = computed<Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-label'>>(() => ({

}));
function updateDraft(value: string | number) {
	draft.value = String(value);
}
let abort: AbortController | undefined;
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
function refresh() {
	abort?.abort();
	clearTimeout(timer);
	abort = new AbortController();
	const signal = abort.signal;
	loading.value = true;
	emit('lifecycle', 'task-start', props.id);
	timer = setTimeout(() => {
		if (!signal.aborted) {
			activities.value = [
				{ id: nextActivityId++, label: 'activityRefreshed' },
				...activities.value.slice(0, 2)
			];
			loading.value = false;
			timer = undefined;
			emit('lifecycle', 'task-complete', props.id);
		}
	}, 120);
}
onMounted(() => emit('lifecycle', 'mount', props.id));
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	abort?.abort();
	clearTimeout(timer);
	if (timer !== undefined) emit('lifecycle', 'task-abort', props.id);
	emit('lifecycle', 'unmount', props.id);
});

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/desktop/examples/App.vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import MinimalDesktop from '../templates/desktop/MinimalDesktop.vue';
import ExamplePanel from '../templates/desktop/examples/ExamplePanel.vue';
import { createDesktop } from '../templates/desktop/Desktop.js';
import { browserStorage } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { panels, desktopConfig } from '../templates/desktop/examples/config.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	const placeholder = defineComponent(() => () => h('div'));
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: placeholder },
			{ path: '/guide', component: placeholder }
		]
	});
	const application = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	application.mount(element);
	if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('test'))
		Object.assign(window, {
			desktopApplication: application,
			createDesktopPeer(owner) {
				const container = document.createElement('div');
				container.dataset.peer = 'true';
				document.body.append(container);
				const controller = createDesktop({
					app: desktopConfig.app,
					owner,
					scope: desktopConfig.scope,
					panels,
					storage: browserStorage()
				});
				const peer = createApp({
					render: () =>
						h(
							AsamApplicationProvider,
							{},
							{
								default: () =>
									h(
										MinimalDesktop,
										{ controller, title: '独立工作台' },
										{
											panel: (scope) =>
												h(ExamplePanel, {
													id: scope.panel.id,
													readonly: scope.readonly,
													disabled: false
												})
										}
									)
							}
						)
				});
				peer.mount(container);
				return {
					controller,
					destroy() {
						peer.unmount();
						controller.dispose();
						container.remove();
					}
				};
			}
		});
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

.desktop {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	--desktop-accent: var(--asam-color-primary);
	--asam-color-text-secondary: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.desktop *,
.desktop *::before,
.desktop *::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.desktop h1,
.desktop h2,
.desktop p {
	margin: 0;
}
.desktop :focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--desktop-accent);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.desktop button:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
}
.desktop-stage {
	min-width: 0;
}
.desktop-launcher {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
	padding-block: 16px;
}
.desktop-launch-symbol {
	display: inline-grid;
	place-items: center;
	width: 20px;
	height: 20px;
	margin-right: 8px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-info);
	color: var(--desktop-accent);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.desktop-tools {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: flex-end;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	padding-block: 8px 14px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.desktop-tools [role='status'] {
	margin-right: auto;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-surface {
	position: relative;
	height: clamp(480px, 65dvh, 720px);
	min-width: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	isolation: isolate;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.desktop-idle {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	justify-content: center;
	align-items: center;
	text-align: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 24px;
}
.desktop-idle > span {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.14em;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-idle h2 {
	font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px);
	font-weight: 500;
}
.desktop-window {
	position: absolute;
	top: 0;
	left: 0;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-default, 8px);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	overflow: hidden;
	animation: desktop-enter 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) both;
}
.desktop-window.is-active {
	border-color: var(--desktop-accent);
	box-shadow: var(--asam-shadow-card);
}
.desktop-titlebar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
	min-height: 46px;
	padding: 5px 8px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	flex-shrink: 0;
}
.desktop-move {
	min-width: 0;
	flex: 1;
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	border: 0;
	background: transparent;
	color: inherit;
	text-align: left;
	cursor: grab;
	touch-action: none;
	padding: 6px 2px;
}
.desktop-move strong {
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
	white-space: nowrap;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.desktop-grip {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-window-actions {

}
.desktop-window-actions button:not([class*='el-']) {
	min-width: 28px;

}
.desktop-window-content {

}
.desktop-window-content .asam-page-container {

}
.desktop-window-content .asam-page-container-header:empty {

}
.desktop-panel-description {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);

	margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}
.desktop-resize {
	position: absolute;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	width: 28px;
	height: 28px;

}
.desktop-footer {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	justify-content: space-between;

	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	padding-block: 12px 20px;
}
.desktop-stage[data-narrow='true'] .desktop-surface {
	height: min(65dvh, 640px);
	min-height: 360px;
}
.desktop-stage[data-size='small'] .desktop-titlebar {
	min-height: 40px;
}
.desktop-stage[data-size='big'] .desktop-titlebar {
	min-height: 50px;
}
.desktop-stage[data-size='large'] .desktop-titlebar {
	min-height: 54px;
}
.desktop-minimal {
	padding: 24px clamp(16px, 4vw, 56px) 0;
}
.desktop-edition {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	justify-content: space-between;
	border-bottom: 2px solid var(--asam-color-text-primary);
	padding-bottom: 12px;
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.desktop-intro {
	padding-block: 28px 20px;
	display: flex;
	align-items: flex-end;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 24px;
}
.desktop-intro h1 {
	font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', serif;
	font-weight: 500;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px);
	letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.desktop-intro p {
	max-width: 30em;
	font-size: 13px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-minimal .desktop-surface {
	background-image: radial-gradient(var(--asam-color-border) 0.6px, transparent 0.6px);
	background-size: 16px 16px;
}
.desktop-minimal .desktop-window {
	border-radius: 4px;
}
.desktop-brand {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 244px minmax(0, 1fr);
	min-height: 100%;
}
.desktop-brand-rail {
	padding: 36px 28px;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	background: var(--asam-semantic-brand-surface);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
	overflow: hidden;
}
.desktop-wordmark {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: 30px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.06em;
	text-decoration: none;
}
.desktop-wordmark span {
	display: block;
	font-size: 10px;
	letter-spacing: 0.22em;
	margin-top: 8px;
}
.desktop-brand-story {
	margin-block: 64px 32px;
}
.desktop-brand-story h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	line-height: 1.5;
	letter-spacing: -0.04em;
	margin-block: 16px;
}
.desktop-brand-story p {
	font-size: 12px;
	line-height: 1.9;
}
.desktop-brand-rail nav a {
	color: inherit;
}
.desktop.desktop-brand .desktop-brand-rail nav a {
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
}
.desktop-brand-mark {
	margin-top: auto;
	padding-top: 48px;
	font-size: 120px;
	line-height: 1;
	letter-spacing: -0.12em;
	opacity: 0.2;
}
.desktop-brand-main {
	padding: 28px clamp(16px, 3vw, 40px) 0;
	min-width: 0;
}
.desktop-brand-top {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 8px;
	padding-bottom: 22px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.desktop-brand-top strong {
	font-size: 24px;
	font-weight: 500;
}
.desktop-brand-top span {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.desktop-brand .desktop-surface {
	border-radius: 12px;
}
.desktop-brand .desktop-window {
	border-radius: 10px;
}
.desktop-tech {
	padding: 24px clamp(12px, 3vw, 40px) 0;
}
.desktop-tech-top {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: flex-end;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 20px;
	border-bottom: 2px solid var(--desktop-accent);
	padding-bottom: 24px;
}
.desktop-tech-kicker {
	font:
		11px ui-monospace,
		monospace;
	letter-spacing: 0.16em;
	color: var(--desktop-accent);
}
.desktop-tech-top h1 {
	margin-top: 16px;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
	font-weight: 500;
	letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.desktop-tech-top p {
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-tech-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 20px;
}
.desktop-tech-index {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 24px;
	padding-top: 24px;
	font:
		10px ui-monospace,
		monospace;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
.desktop-tech-index > span:first-child {
	font-size: 30px;
	color: var(--desktop-accent);
}
.desktop-tech-index i {
	width: 1px;
	flex: 1;
	background: var(--asam-color-border);
}
.desktop-tech-index small {
	font-size: 9px;
	padding-bottom: 16px;
}
.desktop-tech .desktop-window {
	border-radius: 0;
	border-width: 1px;
}
.desktop-tech .desktop-titlebar {
	border-left: 3px solid var(--desktop-accent);
}
.desktop-tech .desktop-surface {
	background-image:
		linear-gradient(var(--asam-color-border) 1px, transparent 1px),
		linear-gradient(90deg, var(--asam-color-border) 1px, transparent 1px);
	background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.desktop-tech .desktop-taskbar {
	border-top: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
@keyframes desktop-enter {
	from {
		opacity: 0;
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
	.desktop-intro {
		align-items: flex-start;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 12px;
	}
	.desktop-brand {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.desktop-brand-rail {
		padding: 18px 20px;
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
		align-items: center;
		gap: 12px;
	}
	.desktop-brand-story {
		margin: 0;
		text-align: right;
	}
	.desktop-brand-story h1 {
		font-size: 18px;
		margin: 0;
	}
	.desktop-brand-story p,
	.desktop-brand-mark {
		display: none;
	}
	.desktop-brand-rail nav {
		grid-column: 1 / -1;
	}
	.desktop-tech-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.desktop-tech-index {
		display: none;
	}
	.desktop-launcher {
		gap: 8px;
	}
	.desktop-window-content {
		padding-inline: 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.desktop-window {
		animation: none;
	}
	.desktop *,
	.desktop *::before,
	.desktop *::after {
		transition-duration: 0s !important;
		scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	}
}

let abort;
let timer;
function refresh() {
	abort?.abort();
	clearTimeout(timer);
	abort = new AbortController();
	const signal = abort.signal;
	loading.value = true;
	emit('lifecycle', 'task-start', props.id);
	timer = setTimeout(() => {
		if (!signal.aborted) {
			activities.value = [
				{ id: nextActivityId++, label: 'activityRefreshed' },
				...activities.value.slice(0, 2)

			loading.value = false;

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	abort?.abort();
	clearTimeout(timer);
	if (timer !== undefined) emit('lifecycle', 'task-abort', props.id);
	emit('lifecycle', 'unmount', props.id);

import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from './App.vue';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import MinimalDesktop from '../MinimalDesktop.vue';
import ExamplePanel from './ExamplePanel.vue';
import { createDesktop } from '../Desktop.js';
import { browserStorage } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
import { panels, desktopConfig } from './config.js';
const placeholder = defineComponent(() => () => h('div'));
const router = createRouter({
	history: createWebHistory(),
	routes: [
		{ path: '/', component: placeholder },
		{ path: '/guide', component: placeholder }
	]
});
const application = createApp(App).use(router);
await router.isReady();
application.mount('#app');
if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('test'))
	Object.assign(window, {
		desktopApplication: application,
		createDesktopPeer(owner) {
			const container = document.createElement('div');
			container.dataset.peer = 'true';
			document.body.append(container);
			const controller = createDesktop({
				app: desktopConfig.app,
				owner,
				scope: desktopConfig.scope,
				panels,
				storage: browserStorage()
			});
			const peer = createApp({
				render: () =>
					h(
						AsamApplicationProvider,
						{},
						{
							default: () =>
								h(
									MinimalDesktop,
									{ controller, title: '独立工作台' },
									{
										panel: (scope) =>
											h(ExamplePanel, {
												id: scope.panel.id,
												readonly: scope.readonly,
												disabled: false
											})
									}
								)
						}
					)
			});
			peer.mount(container);
			return {
				controller,
				destroy() {
					peer.unmount();
					controller.dispose();
					container.remove();
				}
			};
		}
	});

浏览器桌面

在浏览器工作区内组织本地面板、快捷入口和任务栏。简约、品牌与科技三个页面可以分别编辑，共享同一桌面控制器。

接入

复制完整 desktop 目录和同版 preferences 源码；示例还使用 navigation。安装匹配 UI/Pro 包，依次加载 Element Plus、UI、Pro 和桌面样式。从配套文件中的 website-hosts/desktop.ts 导入 mountWebsiteExample，使用 await mountWebsiteExample(element, onError) 挂载，并在页面销毁时调用返回的释放函数。不把桌面模板当作 npm 子路径。

应用创建并释放控制器，插槽提供本地业务组件。面板 id 来自显式 allowlist，不能当作 URL、动态 import、HTML 或权限凭据。业务请求和后端授权由应用处理。

窗口与布局

打开或激活置顶，最小化保留内容；移动、缩放、最大化和窄屏切换不改变业务实例。关闭、撤权或页面卸载释放内容；控制器由宿主释放。

容器宽度小于 720px 时使用单面板视图。宽屏逻辑 rect 与视口投影分开，窄屏不会覆盖原布局。最多 32 个本地面板；坐标为有限 CSS px、绝对值不超过 100000；最小窗口 280×180，视口更小时缩至视口。

标题与缩放手柄支持方向键，每次 8px、Shift 为 32px。Escape 取消临时预览，指针取消、失焦、滚动、测量或权限/身份变化同样取消。布局按键只在本地手柄处理，不拦截业务输入。

控制器

createDesktop 接收 app、owner、scope、panels，storage 可选，ttl 默认 30 天，breakpoint 默认 720。panels 使用本地 id/title/allowed；每个页面必需 controller，可配置 title/description/size。

提供 open/activate、close/minimize/maximize、setRect/displayRect、setViewport、setPanels、setPolicy、setContext、restore/save/reset、externalChange、snapshot/key、canOperate/dispose。详情与完整类型见本页折叠说明。

页面插槽 panel 接收 panel/window/readonly/close，另有 navigation/footer。retry 事件传面板 id；实例 focus 聚焦工作区，cancel 放弃临时拖缩放。

布局存储

只保存 version/windows/active 与窗口 id/rect/minimized/maximized，业务正文、草稿、凭据和权限结果不持久化。app、owner 与 scope 保留真实类型，数值 0 与字符串 0 不合并。

非法、旧版、未来版、过期或不可用存储回退默认布局；坏记录需要显式重置。多实例同键读前比对，外部变化显示 conflict，由用户恢复或重置。localStorage 不提供跨进程原子比较写入。

本地编辑、策略、权限、身份变化与 dispose 使旧异步操作失效；迟到完成返回 stale，不覆盖新布局。成功写入的准确字节或删除后的 null 单独维护为本 context 基线，回调中新编辑不丢失该基线。旧读取不能覆盖回调内更新的基线；外部新字节不能冒作自身写入。

只读和禁用阻止布局与保存操作，业务插槽仍由应用落实权限。此模板不提供操作系统窗口、系统快捷键、在线账号或真实后端。

许可

桌面第三方声明 与 Pro 许可。
